long_description:
w/ Special Guests Patti Ann Kelly, Willow, MaaShakti Das, and Claire Moore! Alsi Di Pini Prasad provided by Bombay Sweets~

Soul-Nourishing Kirtan: A Night of Inner Peace, Healing, Music, and Community Song with Touring Sadhaka Jordan Loder

Breathe, Heal, Laugh, Cry, Sing, Release, Connect. 

Jordan is currently on his 49-date “Singing Our Hearts Wide Open” Tour across the United States, Canada, and Hawaii. This is one of the stops on that journey.

A touring bhakti artist who has devoted his life to spreading the joy of inner peace through the power of music, Jordan spent nearly a decade on the road supporting beloved artists Snatam Kaur, Deva Premal & Miten, Ajeet, Simrit, and Adam Bauer as tour manager and sound engineer. He now carries that living tradition forward as he travels the world offering his own unique and refreshing style of devotional music.

His heartfelt kirtan (call-and-response singing) is known for its tender, authentic, and introspective quality, igniting an experience of profound healing and a genuine sense of togetherness. With an effortless lightness of being and a childlike spirit of wonder, you will be swept away into a state of total spiritual oneness.

He travels with professional sound, ambient lighting, and projected lyrics, presented with a production sense refined over more than two decades working behind the scenes for some of music’s most legendary artists.

“A true Bhakti yogi, his kirtan transmits unconditional love & devotion and delivers us to an ecstatic experience of the Great Universal Spirit.”

— GuruGanesha, Founder, Spirit Voyage Music

Don’t miss this special opportunity to open your heart and reconnect through music and the healing power of sound. You will form and deepen lasting relationships with amazing people. We would LOVE to have you join us, and promise that you will never forget this one-of-a-kind experience!
